Name: (AT) SVE Recoloured and Tweaked Farm Animals
Author: ValhallaCallsMe
Description:
This mod edits the Stardew Valley Expanded farm animals. Makes the camel taller, slightly tweaked the bear. Gives a few colour options for each animal.

Bear - vanilla tweaked, dark brown, polar bear & panda bear
Camel - vanilla tweaked, dark brown, white
Goose - black beaked

May add more in the future :) any ideas welcome

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] are required. 

Download each file and unzip/extract them into your Stardew mods folder.

In game- use the scissors sold at Robin's to change the skin of each animal.
